question.text: The cut-off time for purchase applications in liquid funds and overnight funds is ________. This is different from the cut-off time for other mutual fund schemes.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series V-A workbook (pp.190-191), the cut-off time for purchase applications in liquid and overnight funds is 1:30 PM. Under the liquid/overnight purchase rule, when the application and funds are received before this cut-off, the applicable NAV is the closing NAV of the day immediately preceding the day of receipt of the application — not the same day's NAV. For other mutual fund schemes (equity, debt, hybrid) the cut-off is 3:00 PM (p.190). The Trap: 3:00 PM (Option D) is the cut-off for other schemes, not for liquid/overnight funds — this is the most common confusion. 12:00 PM and 2:00 PM are not prescribed cut-offs for any standard mutual fund transaction. Also note: the liquid/overnight cut-off does NOT translate into same-day NAV — it triggers the previous-day NAV rule for those schemes. Note: Liquid/overnight fund purchase cut-off = 1:30 PM (with previous-day NAV under the liquid-fund rule when met). Other funds = 3:00 PM (with funds-availability driving NAV for equity/debt). The earlier cut-off allows AMCs to deploy funds in money-market instruments the same day.
